name: exact-point
label: Exact single-point check
description: Verify an exact claim about one concrete assignment (a witness value, a computed constant, a specific trajectory property). The verifier recomputes the expression and applies the predicate. Exit 0 = verified (finite, complete for this point).

inputs.name: expression
inputs.description: integer arithmetic over the assignment variables

inputs.name: predicate
inputs.description: e.g. equals:111 | prime | collatz_steps_equals… (use collatz_steps_less_than:K etc.)
